title: Observability for Delegated Execution in Agentic AI Systems
title_zh: Agentic AI 系统中委托执行的可观测性
abstract_en: Delegation-scoped execution is not identifiable from standard observables: audit logs and execution traces can be identical under multiple incompatible delegation assignments. This gap is especially acute in LLM-based agentic systems, where agents dynamically select tools, vary execution sequences across runs for the same instruction, and spawn cooperating sub-agents. These dynamics fragment and interleave traces, making delegation-scoped reconstruction from causal structure alone structurally underdetermined. Although individual actions are authorized and logged, existing audit, tracing, and security schemas lack the semantics to reconstruct what actions occurred under a given delegation across heterogeneous systems. We focus on delegation-scoped attribution and access/share footprint reconstruction, not intent inference or reasoning reconstruction. We present an agent-aware observability substrate consisting of a lightweight gateway and a common information model that binds delegation context at execution time. This enables reliable cross-tool delegation-scoped reconstruction and direct forensic queries without heuristic time-window correlation.
abstract_zh: 本文指出，标准可观测信号（如 audit logs 和 execution traces）无法唯一识别 delegation-scoped execution：相同日志与轨迹可能对应多种互不兼容的委托分配。在基于 LLM 的 agentic systems 中，这一问题更突出，因为 agent 会动态选择 tools、同一指令在不同运行中产生不同执行序列，并可能生成协作 sub-agents，导致轨迹碎片化和交错，使得仅依赖因果结构进行委托范围重建在结构上欠定。尽管单个动作可能已被授权并记录，现有 audit、tracing 与 security schemas 缺少跨异构系统重建特定 delegation 下动作及访问/共享足迹所需的语义。论文聚焦 delegation-scoped attribution 以及 access/share footprint reconstruction，而非意图推断或推理过程重建。作者提出一种 agent-aware observability substrate，由轻量级 gateway 和 common information model 组成，在执行时绑定 delegation context，从而支持可靠的跨工具委托范围重建和直接取证查询，避免依赖启发式时间窗口关联。
key_points_zh: 指出标准 audit logs 与 execution traces 无法唯一还原 delegation-scoped execution，存在结构性不可识别问题。
分析 LLM-based agentic systems 中动态 tool selection、非确定性执行序列和 sub-agent 协作会导致轨迹碎片化与交错，加剧委托归因困难。
论文目标限定在 delegation-scoped attribution 与 access/share footprint reconstruction，不涉及 intent inference 或 reasoning reconstruction。
提出 agent-aware observability substrate，通过 lightweight gateway 与 common information model 在执行时绑定 delegation context。
该方法支持跨异构工具的委托范围重建与直接 forensic queries，减少对启发式时间窗口关联的依赖。

llm_assessment.comment: High-value observability infrastructure for delegated agent execution, directly addressing attribution, auditability, and cross-tool forensic reconstruction.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项高价值的委托式智能体执行可观测性基础设施工作，直接解决归因、审计和跨工具取证重建问题。
